desc: Ideate approaches and choose binary-search feasibility as the primary method.
Implement input parsing for N and the sorted list A.
Write a feasibility function check(K) that verifies whether the K smallest mochi can be paired with the K largest mochi using the condition 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i].
Binary search K over the range 0 to N//2 using the feasibility function to find the maximum valid K.
Ensure the solution runs in O(N log N) time or better and uses O(N) memory.
Test mentally and by running sample tests on edge cases such as N=2, all equal sizes, and cases where no pair is possible.
